name: Psychic Detective Series Vol. 1: Invitation - Kage kara no Shoutaijou
original_name: サイキック・ディテクティブ・シリーズ Vol.1 インビテーション 影からの招待状
source:
Katsuya Furuyagi is more than just a private investigator with a troubled past. He is also a psychic detective - a person who possesses extraordinary powers which allow him to "dive" into minds of people. One day he is contacted by the wealthy Shiratori family; their youngest member, the sixteen-year-old Asami, has lost her consciousness under mysterious circumstances and cannot recover. Furuyagi has to use his special abilities and learn more about the family's secrets in order to bring the girl back.

[From [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/psychic-detective-series-vol1-invitation-kage-kara-no-shtaij]Moby Games[/url]]
translation:
降矢木勝也不只是一名背負痛苦往事的私家偵探。他還是一名靈能偵探，擁有能夠「潛入」他人心靈的非凡力量。一天，富裕的白鳥家聯絡了他。家中最年幼的成員、16歲的麻美在離奇情形下失去意識，至今未能甦醒。為了喚回少女，降矢木必須運用特殊能力，深入瞭解這個家族的秘密。

［引自[url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/psychic-detective-series-vol1-invitation-kage-kara-no-shtaij]Moby Games[/url]］
